prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Atlanta after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — and I’d recommend you call several firms and compare. Before I pull up current phone numbers/links for you, a few quick questions so I give the best matches:
- Were you injured (how badly) and do you have medical treatment ongoing?
- Which part of Atlanta (city/county or nearby suburb)?
- Do you prefer a large/national firm or a smaller local/boutique trial firm?

If you want me to look up contact info now I can do that — say “yes” and tell me the neighborhood/county.

Below are specific Atlanta firms you should consider calling and why each is worth contacting. These are firms known to handle car-accident/personal-injury cases (I can fetch current phone numbers/links if you want):

- Morgan & Morgan (Atlanta)
  - Why call: One of the largest plaintiff personal-injury firms in the U.S., significant resources for investigation and expert witnesses, handles a high volume of car-accident cases on contingency and offers free consultations. Good if you want a firm with wide resources and experience handling serious injury claims.

- The Cochran Firm (Atlanta)
  - Why call: Nationally known trial firm with experience in high-profile and complex injury cases. Often takes on cases that need aggressive negotiation or trial experience.

- Pope McGlamry (Atlanta)
  - Why call: Atlanta-based plaintiff firm with a history of representing car-accident victims and obtaining large verdicts/settlements. Good option if you prefer a local firm focused on plaintiff work and trial advocacy.

- Simmons & Fletcher (Atlanta)
  - Why call: Longstanding Atlanta personal-injury practice with trial experience and a local reputation for handling auto collisions and catastrophic injury claims.

- Local boutique/trial firms (examples)
  - Why call: Smaller plaintiff-focused firms can offer more individualized attention and often have experienced trial lawyers who handle serious car-accident cases from start to finish.

How to choose which to call (quick checklist of questions to ask during the free consult)
- Have you handled cases like mine (car accident with [describe your injuries])? How many and what were the outcomes?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day (attorney or paralegal)?
- Do you work on contingency, and what is your fee percentage? Are there any additional costs I might owe?
- How often will you communicate with me and how quickly do you return calls/messages?
- Do you have references or client reviews? Any notable verdicts/settlements?
- Do you expect this case will settle or go to trial (and why)?

Immediate steps you should take right now (if not already done)
- Get medical treatment and keep all medical records/ bills.
- Report the crash to police and get the accident report number.
- Take photos of vehicles, injuries, the scene, and get witness contact info.
- Preserve evidence (don’t post injury details/public admissions on social media; don’t sign releases or give recorded statements to insurers without your lawyer).
- Note deadlines: Georgia has a statute of limitations for personal injury claims (generally two years from the date of injury), so don’t delay.

If you’d like, I can:
- Look up current phone numbers and websites for the firms above and others near your neighborhood, or
- Narrow the list to boutique trial firms vs. national firms depending on your preference, or
- Draft a short script of what to say on the initial call.

Which would you prefer?
